open_points.subject: Security review scope for authentication and credential abuse
open_points.text: authentication_credential_abuse: APPLICABLE; references: A3, A4, A10, A11, A16, A17, A25; affected: M01-M15, staff login, viewer entry, producer bearer authentication
open_points.question: After M08–M12 were removed, does this category apply only to the surviving models among M01–M15, or are replacement authentication concepts intended for the now-undefined model identifiers?
options: Interpret M01-M15 as the surviving models only, skipping M08-M12
Define replacement models or security-review subjects for M08-M12
Replace the range with an explicit list of surviving affected models
open_points.default_guess: Replace the range with an explicit list of the surviving affected models.

witness.initial: The accepted texts remove models M08–M12 but A31 still declares the entire range M01–M15 affected by authentication and credential abuse.
events: A later agent maps every A31 affected model to modules and security checks.
The agent reaches the undefined identifiers M08–M12.
outcomes: The agent silently skips M08–M12 and reviews only the surviving models.
The agent invents placeholder or replacement authentication modules for M08–M12 to satisfy the stated range.
witness.observer: Later architecture, security-review, and test agents see different required module and test scopes.
